001
002package dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.node;
003
004import java.util.Collection;
005import java.util.List;
006import java.util.Map;
007
008import dev.metaschema.core.qname.IEnhancedQName;
009import dev.metaschema.core.util.CollectionUtil;
010import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
011
012/**
013 * This mixin interface indicates that the implementation is a {@link INodeItem}
014 * that may have both flag and model children.
015 */
016public interface IFeatureModelContainerItem extends IFeatureFlagContainerItem {
017
018  @Override
019  ModelContainer getModel();
020
021  @Override
022  default Collection<? extends List<? extends IModelNodeItem<?, ?>>> getModelItems() {
023    return getModel().getModelItems();
024  }
025
026  @Override
027  default List<? extends IModelNodeItem<?, ?>> getModelItemsByName(IEnhancedQName name) {
028    return getModel().getModelItemsByName(name);
029  }
030
031  /**
032   * Provides an abstract implementation of a lazy loaded model.
033   */
034  class ModelContainer
035      extends FlagContainer {
036    private final Map<Integer, List<? extends IModelNodeItem<?, ?>>> modelItems;
037
038    /**
039     * Creates a new collection of flags and model items.
040     *
041     * @param flags
042     *          a mapping of flag name to a flag item
043     * @param modelItems
044     *          a mapping of model item name to a list of model items
045     */
046    protected ModelContainer(
047        @NonNull Map<Integer, IFlagNodeItem> flags,
048        @NonNull Map<Integer, List<? extends IModelNodeItem<?, ?>>> modelItems) {
049      super(flags);
050      this.modelItems = modelItems;
051    }
052
053    /**
054     * Get the matching list of model items having the provided name.
055     *
056     * @param name
057     *          the name of the model items to retrieve
058     * @return a lisy of matching model items or {@code null} if no match was found
059     */
060    @NonNull
061    public List<? extends IModelNodeItem<?, ?>> getModelItemsByName(@NonNull IEnhancedQName name) {
062      List<? extends IModelNodeItem<?, ?>> result = modelItems.get(name.getIndexPosition());
063      return result == null ? CollectionUtil.emptyList() : result;
064    }
065
066    /**
067     * Get all model items grouped by model item name.
068     *
069     * @return a collection of lists containg model items grouped by names
070     */
071    @SuppressWarnings("null")
072    @NonNull
073    public Collection<List<? extends IModelNodeItem<?, ?>>> getModelItems() {
074      return modelItems.values();
075    }
076  }
077}
